articles.title: US and Iran trade strikes after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: The US military says it hit missile sites and command centres while Iran says it attacked US bases.

articles.title: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
articles.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.

articles.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
articles.description: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

articles.title: Zimbabwean football star survives gun attack in South Africa
articles.description: South African police say they are investigating a case of attempted murder but that no arrests have been made so far.

articles.title: Far-right French leader Le Pen to run in next presidential election after court ruling
articles.description: Far-right leader Marine Le Pen says she’ll run for the French presidency next year after the decision of an appeals court cleared her way.

articles.title: US accuses China of nuclear proliferation after ballistic missile test
articles.description: The US called China's ballistic missile test in the south Pacific a "great concern" for the world.
